# Saheed Olaide (@sirsahol) — Technical Architecture Portfolio

> Principal Systems Architect & Technical Operator
> Specializing in Apple Silicon MLX model quantization, distributed tailnet device meshes, and high-trust edge cloud infrastructure.

## Core Specializations
- Apple Silicon & Edge ML: Author of mlx-foundry (CLI quantization 4-bit/8-bit/16-bit and LiteRT-LM flatbuffer export) and published open-weight models on Hugging Face Hub (SirSahOl).
- Agent Control Planes & Device Mesh: Multi-node agent orchestration meshes over Tailscale, synchronizing an 18-server MCP SSOT across 4 coding harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code, Antigravity, JeikCode) with HMAC approval gates.
- Background OS Automation: Architect of silicon-grounder, a FastMCP server introducing virtual display coexistence for macOS agents without cursor hijacking.
- FinOps & Autonomous Data Pipelines: Designer of cloud-image-pipeline with $0.50 job spend circuit breakers and serverless SQLite engines with continuous Litestream WAL sync to GCS.
- Frontier Model Evaluation: Maintainer of ai-benchmark-tracker, evaluating 32 frontier models across 16 canonical benchmarks.
